_comment: Phase 8 Step 0: closed-search reference. Narrow ppm precursor tolerance (NOT the open-search Da window) + defined variable-mod list per PLAN Step 0: Oxidation(M), Deamidation(NQ), Acetyl(K and peptide N-term). Phase 6B principle: never combine wide precursor tolerance with relaxed specificity. Generates reference anchor counts (expected_anchors) that Tier 1 checks the open search against, and gives a free digestion/QC cross-check on the same file. Shared human canonical FASTA. mzml_paths repointed per file at run time.
_recon_note: ⚠ DELIBERATELY DIRTY — DO NOT CLEAN. This is the regression fixture for the pass-1 isotope guard (recon-tool/tests/no_mods_guard.rs::pass1_refuses_a_template_with_a_non_zero_isotope_window). It carries isotope_errors [-1,3], and the test asserts that it does before asserting the refusal. Cleaning this file makes that test pass vacuously. It is also the historical closed-search reference config. 2026-09-02: removed database.fragment_min_mz/fragment_max_mz only (deleted from Sage config in v0.15, silently ignored); isotope_errors and variable_mods left untouched.
